claimBoundary: This catalogue supports applicability and evidence review. It does not provide legal advice, certify an organisation, or convert framework maturity into regulatory compliance.

authorities.name: United States Department of Health and Human Services

instruments.title: DAMA-DMBOK2 Data Management Body of Knowledge
instruments.limitation: DMBOK provides professional guidance, not certification or a regulatory conclusion. DGIW uses its own 1-5 maturity scale and editorial crosswalk weights.

instruments.title: Data Management Capability Assessment Model
instruments.limitation: The suite framework scorecard still models DCAM v2.2 and must not be described as a DCAM v3 assessment until its licensed structure is migrated and reviewed.

instruments.title: DGI Data Governance Framework
instruments.limitation: DGI does not publish the 1-5 maturity scale used by DGIW; the grouping and weights are editorial and require reviewer acceptance.

instruments.title: COBIT 2019 — EDM objectives and APO14 Managed Data
instruments.limitation: The DGIW structure and practice wording must be validated against the licensed ISACA publication before audit use.

instruments.title: Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting
instruments.limitation: Applicability depends on supervisory scope and local implementation; inclusion here does not assert that every institution is directly in scope.

instruments.title: Interest rate risk in the banking book
instruments.limitation: Local supervisory implementation and bank-specific model approval remain required.

instruments.title: Corporate Governance Regulatory Framework for Banks/DFIs
instruments.limitation: A qualified Pakistani banking compliance reviewer must confirm entity type, amendments and clause applicability.

instruments.title: Enterprise Technology Governance & Risk Management Framework for Financial Institutions
instruments.limitation: The current consolidated applicability and subsequent circulars require confirmation by the institution's compliance function.

instruments.title: Foreign Exchange Manual
instruments.limitation: This is a living manual. Chapter, circular and effective-date applicability must be confirmed for each trade product and transaction type.

instruments.title: WCO Data Model
instruments.limitation: WCO DM supports interoperability and conformity; it does not replace national customs law or SBP foreign-exchange requirements. The TAIW page still labels its bundled model v4.2.

instruments.title: WHO data principles and digital health governance guidance
instruments.limitation: WHO principles are guidance and must be localized to national health, privacy and professional rules.

instruments.title: HIPAA Security Rule
instruments.version: 45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164 Subparts A and C
instruments.limitation: Applicable only to US covered entities and business associates. It must never be selected merely because a healthcare use case exists.

obligations.title: Establish accountable data governance
obligations.requirement: Define decision rights, ownership, stewardship and escalation for governed data.

obligations.title: Assess capability using auditable evidence
obligations.requirement: Capability conclusions should be supported by participation, repeatable process and reviewable evidence rather than assertion alone.

obligations.title: Operate governance decision rights
obligations.requirement: Document who decides, who is accountable and how controls and exceptions operate.

obligations.title: Govern and manage enterprise data
obligations.requirement: Maintain governance direction and operational data-management practices with accountable monitoring.

obligations.title: Govern risk data aggregation
obligations.requirement: Risk data architecture, accuracy, completeness, timeliness and adaptability must be governed and demonstrable.

obligations.title: Produce reliable risk reports
obligations.requirement: Risk reports should be accurate, comprehensive, clear, useful, frequent and distributed to the right recipients.

obligations.title: Govern IRRBB measurement and oversight
obligations.requirement: Identify, measure, monitor and control IRRBB under governing-body oversight and independent review.

obligations.title: Evidence IRRBB assumptions and scenarios
obligations.requirement: Rate-shock scenarios, behavioural assumptions, EVE/NII results, limits and disclosures must be reproducible and reviewable.

obligations.title: Demonstrate accountable banking governance
obligations.requirement: Governance bodies, senior management and control functions must have documented responsibilities, oversight and escalation.

obligations.title: Integrate technology and data risk controls
obligations.requirement: Technology risks must be identified, measured, monitored and controlled within enterprise risk management.

obligations.reference: Information packages, data sets and code lists
obligations.title: Use governed cross-border data definitions
obligations.requirement: Trade messages and datasets should use controlled definitions, code lists and documented national extensions.

obligations.reference: Applicable chapter and circular — legal review required
obligations.title: Trace foreign-exchange reporting obligations
obligations.requirement: Applicable trade and foreign-exchange requirements must be identified by product, transaction and effective date and traced to source data and returns.

obligations.title: Protect health-data privacy and rights
obligations.requirement: Sensitive health data should be collected, processed, shared and retained under applicable law with privacy, security and human-rights safeguards.

obligations.title: Govern interoperable digital health data
obligations.requirement: Digital health architecture should use governed standards and localization processes supporting safe interoperability.

obligations.title: Implement administrative safeguards for ePHI
obligations.requirement: US regulated entities must perform risk analysis, assign security responsibility and maintain security management procedures.

obligations.title: Implement physical and technical safeguards for ePHI
obligations.requirement: US regulated entities must protect access, integrity and transmission of ePHI through reasonable and appropriate safeguards.

controls.title: Governance authority and accountability
controls.objective: Document the accountable body, decision rights, owners, stewards, escalation path and approval evidence.

controls.title: Jurisdiction and applicability determination
controls.objective: Record why each instrument and obligation applies or does not apply to the organisation, product and use case.

controls.title: Critical-data ownership and definitions
controls.objective: Identify governed data, assign one accountable owner and maintain approved definitions and classifications.

controls.title: Data-quality measurement and remediation
controls.objective: Define measurable rules, thresholds, monitoring and accountable remediation for critical data.

controls.title: End-to-end lineage and reconciliation
controls.objective: Trace regulated or decision-critical outputs to authoritative sources with transformation and reconciliation evidence.

controls.title: Privacy, access and data protection
controls.objective: Apply classification-based access, privacy safeguards and monitored exceptions to sensitive data.

controls.title: Retention and defensible disposal
controls.objective: Maintain approved retention schedules, legal holds, archival controls and evidenced disposal.

controls.title: Model and assumption governance
controls.objective: Version, approve, validate and monitor models, scenarios and material behavioural assumptions.

controls.title: Technology resilience and security
controls.objective: Identify and control technology, cyber, continuity, backup and recovery risks affecting governed data.

controls.title: Interoperability and controlled standards
controls.objective: Use governed data definitions, code lists, message profiles and controlled localization or extension processes.

controls.title: Regulatory and management reporting
controls.objective: Produce complete, timely and approved outputs with submission, distribution and correction controls.

controls.title: Independent review and evidence retention
controls.objective: Retain sufficient evidence for an independent reviewer to reproduce the conclusion and record acceptance or rejection.
